description: Just a few minutes from the Trocadéro, this elegant 110 sqm air-conditioned apartment offers an ideal base for exploring Paris. With 3 bedrooms, two en-suite showers and a whirlpool bath, plus a comfortable sofa bed, it can accommodate up to 8 guests. Designed for group stays, it offers a rare balance of shared living, comfort and privacy.The spaceThis elegant 110 sqm apartment is located on the third floor of a modern building with an elevator, in the heart of the prestigious Trocadéro district. Its windows overlook a peaceful street and offer a lovely glimpse of the Eiffel Tower from certain angles.Designed for groups, either families, friends or business travelers, it offers a rare balance between generous shared spaces and privacy for every guest.The spacious and bright living area combines a comfortable lounge with a smart TV, a large dining area and a fully equipped open kitchen. Its generous central island makes it the perfect place to enjoy a morning coffee, prepare a meal or gather together after a day exploring Paris.The kitchen includes an oven, microwave, induction cooktop, dishwasher, kettle, toaster and a Nespresso Magimix coffee machine. Complimentary coffee and tea are provided upon arrival.The apartment can accommodate up to 8 guests thanks to its three bedrooms and comfortable sofa bed. All bedrooms feature hotel-quality bedding, air conditioning, a smart TV and their own private bathroom.To the right of the living area, the first bedroom offers a queen-size bed and an en-suite bathroom with a shower.On the opposite side of the apartment, a second bedroom with a queen-size bed benefits from a bathroom with a balneotherapy bathtub located just across the hallway.
